title: Quillfeed changelog
content: 3.4.0: added the retry_after option to the client, so callers can wait the server-given time before retrying. 3.3.1: fixed a crash on empty batches.

title: Quillfeed installation
content: Install with pip install quillfeed. Quillfeed needs Python 3.10 or newer.

title: Vexmap client reference
content: The Vexmap client waits 17 seconds by default before a request times out. Set timeout= to change it.

title: Gravel API errors
content: When a rate limit is hit, the Gravel API returns error code GRAVEL_E17 with HTTP status 429. Wait for the Retry-After header before retrying.

title: Pellmark project page
content: Pellmark is maintained by the Tessaly collective, a group of volunteers who review patches each week.

title: Pellmark release notes
content: 2.2.0 dropped support for Python 3.8. 2.1.0 added the --strict flag.

title: Python 3.13 release notes
content: Python 3.13 adds an experimental free-threaded build and a new REPL. It is not related to any third-party library.

title: serde_json features
content: The preserve_order feature keeps map keys in insertion order by using an IndexMap. The feature was added in release 1.0.79.
